##Prepare
```{r chunk08_1}
max_row <- floor(NROW(data_country_clean) / 10) * 10
lib_ccm <- c(5,max_row,5)
seed_num <- 3121
sur_num <- 100
sam_num <- 100

# Generate pairwise variable combinations for CCM
all_vars_other <- c(virus_name,"INF_A","INF_B","INF_ALL")
all_vars_flu <- c("INF_A","INF_B","INF_ALL","Vaccine","Temp","AH")

var_pairs1 <- expand.grid(all_vars_other, all_vars_flu)
var_pairs1 <- var_pairs1[-which(var_pairs1$Var1 == "INF_A" & var_pairs1$Var2 == "INF_B"), ]
var_pairs1 <- var_pairs1[-which(var_pairs1$Var1 == "INF_B" & var_pairs1$Var2 == "INF_A"), ]
var_pairs1 <- var_pairs1[-which(var_pairs1$Var1 == "INF_A" & var_pairs1$Var2 == "INF_ALL"), ]
var_pairs1 <- var_pairs1[-which(var_pairs1$Var1 == "INF_ALL" & var_pairs1$Var2 == "INF_A"), ]
var_pairs1 <- var_pairs1[-which(var_pairs1$Var1 == "INF_B" & var_pairs1$Var2 == "INF_ALL"), ]
var_pairs1 <- var_pairs1[-which(var_pairs1$Var1 == "INF_ALL" & var_pairs1$Var2 == "INF_B"), ]

var_pairs2 <- expand.grid(all_vars_flu, all_vars_other)
var_pairs <- rbind(var_pairs1,var_pairs2)
var_pairs <- var_pairs[var_pairs$Var1 != var_pairs$Var2, ]
var_pairs <- t(var_pairs)
colnames(var_pairs) <- paste0(var_pairs[1,],":",var_pairs[2,])
all_vars1 <- unique(colnames(var_pairs)) 
var_pairs <- var_pairs[, order(var_pairs[1,])]
print(var_pairs)
print(all_vars1)
```

## Convergent Cross-Mapping
Run CCM between cases and each driver. 
CCM using the actual data.
```{r chunk08_02_CCM}
# CCM
ccm_obs_summary <- foreach(var = all_vars1, .packages = needed_packages) %dopar% {

  ccm_result <- CCM(dataFrame = data_country_clean, 
                    E = ccm_parameter[, paste0("E_", var_pairs[1,var])], 
                    #tau=1,
                    Tp=-1,
		    columns = var_pairs[1,var],
                    target = var_pairs[2,var], 
                    seed = seed_num,
                    libSizes = lib_ccm, 
                    sample = sam_num,
                    includeData = TRUE,
                    showPlot = F)
  
  # Calculate mean, median, and quantiles of rho
  quantiles <- ccm_result[["CCM1_PredictStat"]] %>%
  group_by(LibSize) %>%
  summarise(
    rho_mean = mean(rho),
    rho_Q50 = quantile(rho, 0.5),
    rho_Q2.5 = quantile(rho, 0.025),
    rho_Q97.5 = quantile(rho, 0.975)
  ) %>%
    select(-"LibSize")
  
  quantiles_rev <- ccm_result[["CCM2_PredictStat"]] %>%
  group_by(LibSize) %>%
  summarise(
    rho_rev_mean = mean(rho),
    rho_rev_Q50 = quantile(rho, 0.5),
    rho_rev_Q2.5 = quantile(rho, 0.025),
    rho_rev_Q97.5 = quantile(rho, 0.975)
  )  %>%
    select(-"LibSize")
    
  colnames(ccm_result[["LibMeans"]])[2] <- "rho"
  colnames(ccm_result[["LibMeans"]])[3] <- "rho_rev"
  
  merged_data <- cbind(ccm_result[["LibMeans"]], quantiles, quantiles_rev)
  return(merged_data)
}

names(ccm_obs_summary) <- all_vars1
```


#CCM using the ebisuzaki null data.
```{r chunk08_03_CCM_ebisuzaki}
# CCM using the ebisuzaki null data
ccm_ebi_summary <- foreach(var = all_vars1, .packages = needed_packages) %dopar% {
  ccm_result_list <- foreach(num = 1:sur_num) %dopar% {
    result <- CCM(dataFrame = data_country_obs_null, 
                  E = ccm_parameter[, paste0("E_", var_pairs[1,var])], 
                  columns = var_pairs[1,var],
                  target =  paste0(var_pairs[2,var], "_ebi.", num),
                  #tau=1,
                  Tp=-1,
		  seed = seed_num,
                  libSizes = lib_ccm, 
                  sample = sam_num)

    colnames(result)[2] <- "rho"
    colnames(result)[3] <- "rho_rev"
    result$sur_id <- num

    return(result)
  }
  
  ccm_result_combined <- do.call(bind_rows, ccm_result_list)  
  # Calculate mean, median, and quantiles of rho
  quantiles <- ccm_result_combined %>%
  group_by(LibSize) %>%
  summarise(
    rho_mean = mean(rho),
    rho_Q50 = quantile(rho, 0.5),
    rho_Q2.5 = quantile(rho, 0.025),
    rho_Q97.5 = quantile(rho, 0.975)
  )
  
  quantiles_rev <- ccm_result_combined %>%
  group_by(LibSize) %>%
  summarise(
    rho_rev_mean = mean(rho_rev),
    rho_rev_Q50 = quantile(rho_rev, 0.5),
    rho_rev_Q2.5 = quantile(rho_rev, 0.025),
    rho_rev_Q97.5 = quantile(rho_rev, 0.975)
  ) %>%
    select(-"LibSize")
    
  merged_data <- cbind(quantiles, quantiles_rev) 

  return(list(ccm_ebi_all = ccm_result_combined, ccm_ebi_95ci = merged_data))
}

names(ccm_ebi_summary) <- all_vars1

```

#CCM to obtain null distributions.
```{r chunk08_06_obtain_null_distributions}
combined_data <- lapply(all_vars1, function(var) {
  
  ccm_obs  <- ccm_obs_summary[[var]] %>% mutate(method = "Observed")
  
  # 95CI
  ccm_ebi_summary[[var]][["ccm_ebi_95ci"]] <- as.data.frame(ccm_ebi_summary[[var]][["ccm_ebi_95ci"]])
  ccm_ebi_95ci <- ccm_ebi_summary[[var]][["ccm_ebi_95ci"]] %>% mutate(method = "Ebisuzaki", LibSize = ccm_obs$LibSize)
  
  ccm_sea_summary[[var]][["ccm_sea_95ci"]] <- as.data.frame(ccm_sea_summary[[var]][["ccm_sea_95ci"]])
  ccm_sea_95ci <- ccm_sea_summary[[var]][["ccm_sea_95ci"]] %>% mutate(method = "Seasonal", LibSize = ccm_obs$LibSize)

  ccm_ran_summary[[var]][["ccm_ran_95ci"]] <- as.data.frame(ccm_ran_summary[[var]][["ccm_ran_95ci"]])
  ccm_ran_95ci <- ccm_ran_summary[[var]][["ccm_ran_95ci"]] %>% mutate(method = "Random", LibSize = ccm_obs$LibSize)
  
  # Bind the data frames
  ccm_95ci <- bind_rows(ccm_obs, ccm_sea_95ci, ccm_ebi_95ci, ccm_ran_95ci) %>% mutate(RVI_type = var)
  
  # rho all
  ccm_ebi_max <- ccm_ebi_summary[[var]][["ccm_ebi_all"]] %>%
    mutate(method = "Ebisuzaki") %>% 
    mutate(RVI_type = var)%>%
    filter(LibSize == max_row)
  
  ccm_sea_max <- ccm_sea_summary[[var]][["ccm_sea_all"]]   %>% 
    mutate(method = "Seasonal")  %>% 
    mutate(RVI_type = var) %>%
    filter(LibSize == max_row)
  
  ccm_obs_max <- ccm_obs %>% 
    mutate(RVI_type = var) %>%
    filter(LibSize == max_row)
  
   ccm_ran_max <- ccm_ran_summary[[var]][["ccm_ran_all"]]   %>% 
    mutate(method = "Random")  %>% 
    mutate(RVI_type = var) %>%
    filter(LibSize == max_row)
  
  return(list(ccm_95ci = ccm_95ci, ccm_ebi_max = ccm_ebi_max, ccm_sea_max = ccm_sea_max, 
              ccm_obs_max=ccm_obs_max, ccm_ran_max=ccm_ran_max))
})

ccm_95ci_country <- do.call(rbind, lapply(combined_data, function(x) x$ccm_95ci)) %>%
  mutate(country = country_name) %>%
  select(country, RVI_type, method, LibSize, everything())

ccm_ebi_max_country <- do.call(rbind, lapply(combined_data, function(x) x$ccm_ebi_max)) %>%
  mutate(country = country_name) %>%
  select(country, RVI_type, method, LibSize, everything())

ccm_sea_max_country <- do.call(rbind, lapply(combined_data, function(x) x$ccm_sea_max)) %>%
  mutate(country = country_name) %>%
  select(country, RVI_type, method, LibSize, everything())

ccm_ran_max_country <- do.call(rbind, lapply(combined_data, function(x) x$ccm_ran_max)) %>%
  mutate(country = country_name) %>%
  select(country, RVI_type, method, LibSize, everything())

ccm_obs_max_country <- do.call(rbind, lapply(combined_data, function(x) x$ccm_obs_max)) %>%
  mutate(country = country_name) %>%
  select(country, RVI_type, method, LibSize, rho, rho_rev)

ccm_95ci_all <-  ccm_95ci_country
ccm_ebi_max_all <-  ccm_ebi_max_country
ccm_sea_max_all <- ccm_sea_max_country
ccm_obs_max_all <-  ccm_obs_max_country
ccm_ran_max_all <-  ccm_ran_max_country
```

## Surrogate-Based Significance Tests
```{r chunk08_07_estimate_a_p-value}
# Seasonal surrogate test
ccm_sea_p <- do.call(rbind, lapply(all_vars1, function(var) {
  sea_rho <- subset(ccm_sea_max_all, RVI_type == var)
  obs_rho <- ccm_obs_max_all[which(ccm_obs_max_all$RVI_type==var), ]
  p_sea <- 1 - ecdf(sea_rho$rho)(obs_rho$rho)
  p_rev_sea <- 1 - ecdf(sea_rho$rho_rev)(obs_rho$rho_rev)
  #p_value <- (sum(obs_rho$rho < sea_rho$rho) + 1) / (length(sea_rho$rho) + 1)
  data.frame(RVI_type = var, p_sea = p_sea, p_rev_sea= p_rev_sea)
}))

print(ccm_sea_p)

# Ebisuzaki surrogate test
ccm_ebi_p <- do.call(rbind, lapply(all_vars1, function(var) {
  ebi_rho <- subset(ccm_ebi_max_all, RVI_type == var)
  obs_rho <- ccm_obs_max_all[which(ccm_obs_max_all$RVI_type==var), ]
  p_ebi <- 1 - ecdf(ebi_rho$rho)(obs_rho$rho)
  p_rev_ebi <- 1 - ecdf(ebi_rho$rho_rev)(obs_rho$rho_rev)
  #p_value <- (sum(obs_rho$rho < sea_rho$rho) + 1) / (length(sea_rho$rho) + 1)
  data.frame(RVI_type = var, p_ebi = p_ebi, p_rev_ebi= p_rev_ebi)
}))

print(ccm_ebi_p)

# Random surrogate test
ccm_ran_p <- do.call(rbind, lapply(all_vars1, function(var) {
  ran_rho <- subset(ccm_ran_max_all, RVI_type == var)
  obs_rho <- ccm_obs_max_all[which(ccm_obs_max_all$RVI_type==var), ]
  p_ran <- 1 - ecdf(ran_rho$rho)(obs_rho$rho)
  p_rev_ran <- 1 - ecdf(ran_rho$rho_rev)(obs_rho$rho_rev)
  #p_value <- (sum(obs_rho$rho < sea_rho$rho) + 1) / (length(sea_rho$rho) + 1)
  data.frame(RVI_type = var, p_ran = p_ran, p_rev_ran= p_rev_ran)
}))

print(ccm_ran_p)
```

##MannKendall test
```{r chunk08_08_MannKendall}
Kendall_p <- do.call(rbind, lapply(all_vars1, function(var) {
  
  Kendall_tau <- MannKendall(ccm_obs_summary[[var]]$rho)$tau
  Kendall_p <- MannKendall(ccm_obs_summary[[var]]$rho)$sl
  Kendall_rev_tau <- MannKendall(ccm_obs_summary[[var]]$rho_rev)$tau
  Kendall_rev_p <- MannKendall(ccm_obs_summary[[var]]$rho_rev)$sl
  
  data.frame(RVI_type = var, Kendall_tau = Kendall_tau, Kendall_p = Kendall_p,
              Kendall_rev_tau = Kendall_rev_tau, Kendall_rev_p = Kendall_rev_p
             )
}))

print(Kendall_p)
```

```{r chunk08_08_output_result}
colnames(ccm_obs_max_all1)[5] <- "rho_actual_rev"
```
